def sum_div(n):
    """Return the sum of all proper divisors of n (divisors less than n)."""
    if n <= 1:
        return 0
    total = 1  # 1 is always a proper divisor for n > 1
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            total += i
            if i != n // i:
                total += n // i
        i += 1
    return total

assert sum_div(8) == 7
